name: Question 12
problem:
$$
D=[\begin{aligned}3 & -2 & 1 \\ -3 & -2 & -2 \\ 12 & 8 & 5\end{aligned}]
$$

 

If $D=LU$ is the LU decomposition of the matrix $D$ given above, what is the value of ${l}_{32}\cdot {u}_{22}?$
worked_solution:
Let's apply our standard LU factorization algorithm.

We reduce the matrix $D$ to row echelon form to obtain the matrix $U,$ as usual. However, instead of writing zeros below the main diagonal, we will instead write down the entries of the matrix $L.$

$$
\begin{aligned}D & =[\begin{aligned}3 & -2 & 1 \\ -3 & -2 & -2 \\ 12 & 8 & 5\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+1{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}3 & -2 & 1 \\ -1 & -4 & -1 \\ 12 & 8 & 5\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-4){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}3 & -2 & 1 \\ -1 & -4 & -1 \\ \,\,4\,\, & 16 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+4{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}3 & -2 & 1 \\ -1 & -4 & -1 \\ \,\,4\,\, & -4 & -3\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we obtain

$$
L=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 \\ 4 & -4 & 1\end{aligned}],\,U=[\begin{aligned}3 & -2 & 1 \\ 0 & -4 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & -3\end{aligned}].
$$

Finally, since ${l}_{32}=-4$ and ${u}_{22}=-4,$ we get

$$
{l}_{32}\cdot {u}_{22}=(-4)\cdot (-4)=16.
$$
